label.zh: 按帝国类型的渗透警告
label.en: Infiltration warnings by empire type

note.zh: 一般帝国、蜂巢思维、灵能物种与机械智能各收到对应的一种；灵能物种的蜂巢帝国可能同时收到两种。只有一般帝国（2085）与机械智能（2313）有后续。
note.en: Ordinary, hive-mind, psionic and machine empires each get their own version; a psionic hive may receive two. Only the ordinary (2085) and machine (2313) versions have follow-ups.

label.zh: 合成人恐怖事件（每次随机其一）

note.zh: 直到完成合成人检测项目或危机结束，每年有机会随机发生一件；除炸弹袭击外每种每个帝国最多一次。
note.en: Until the detection project is finished or the crisis ends, one random incident may occur each year; apart from the bombing, each can happen once per empire.

label.zh: 对机械智能的破坏（每次随机其一）
label.en: Sabotage against a Machine Intelligence (one per roll)

note.zh: 安全防线被突破后，只要仍受幽灵信号影响，每年有机会随机发生一件。
note.en: After the security breach, while the Ghost Signal still affects you, one random incident may occur each year.

label.zh: 主机核心
label.en: The Mainframe Core

note.zh: 按最终世界是被摧毁还是被护盾封存，二者择一；只发给人类摧毁者。
note.en: One of the two, depending on whether the final world was destroyed or shielded; only for a human destroyer.

label.zh: 胜利：肃正协议的终结
label.en: Victory: the end of the Contingency

note.zh: 摧毁CX-9881的最终机械世界后危机结束；之后可能有主机核心、机械堕落帝国关闭与赛博勒克斯离去等余波。脚本中没有肃正协议获胜的结局事件。
note.en: Destroying the final Machine World in CX-9881 ends the crisis; the Mainframe Core, the shutdown of machine Fallen Empires and the Cybrex departure may follow. The scripts contain no ending event for a Contingency victory.

crisis.2403.zh: 联络赛博勒克斯（可重复）

notes.zh: 隐藏事件2005在同一时刻排定之后的全部通知：第100–300天异常、第400–600天失踪、第700–900天消失、第1000–1200天召唤、第1400天抵达、第1450–1460天机械星球、第1800–1900天渗透。它们是按时间先后到达的通知，而非同时可选的分支。
notes.en: Hidden crisis.2005 schedules every later notice at once: anomalies on day 100–300, vanishings on day 400–600, disappearances on day 700–900, the Summons on day 1000–1200, the Arrival on day 1400, the Machine Worlds on day 1450–1460 and infiltration on day 1800–1900. They arrive in time order; they are not simultaneous choices.

notes.zh: 抵达时自动为机械智能、个体机械与合成飞升帝国开启。若在此之前已有两座肃正中心被毁，该项目会被中止（00_scripted_effects.txt:5096-5099）。
notes.en: Opened at the Arrival for Machine Intelligences, individual machines and synthetic-ascended empires. It is aborted once two sterilization hubs have been destroyed (00_scripted_effects.txt:5096-5099).

notes.zh: 外交界面中的可重复通讯；机械与合成帝国可多问一个“强制质询”。
notes.en: A repeatable diplomacy screen; machine and synthetic empires get an extra Forced Query.

scope.zh: 完整核对 crisis_events_3.txt 全部可见事件：定时预兆、抵达、四座中心与最终世界、渗透与破坏随机事件、赛博勒克斯支线、结局与余波，以及机械堕落帝国与监管人/帝皇事件。
scope.en: Checked every visible event of crisis_events_3.txt: the timed omens, the Arrival, the four hubs and the final world, the infiltration and sabotage random events, the Cybrex subplot, ending and aftermath, plus the machine Fallen Empire and Custodian/Emperor events.

uncertain: observer.50 (observer copy of crisis.2037) is the root of another reviewer's story (event-observer-50, many callers through destroy_machine_world); it is deliberately not linked here.
crisis.2015/2016 are attached under 2011/2012 because both checks use the same requirement; an empire that gains synthetic pops between day 300 and 400 could see them without the earlier anomaly.
crisis.2037 is reached by destroying hubs at any time after activation; it is attached under the fourth hub for reading order.
